scenes.head: COIN EXPLAINER
scenes.hook: WHAT IS BNB? FROM EXCHANGE COIN TO BLOCKCHAIN
scenes.narration: What is B N B? An exchange coin that became a blockchain.

scenes.head: WHAT IT IS
scenes.hook: LAUNCHED IN 2017 AS AN EXCHANGE TOKEN
scenes.narration: B N B launched in twenty seventeen as Binance's own token. Today it powers B N B Chain, a network for apps and payments.

scenes.head: WHAT IT DOES
scenes.hook: IT PAYS THE FEES ON THE NETWORK
scenes.narration: Users spend B N B to pay fees on B N B Chain. Validators confirm blocks quickly, so fees are usually low.

scenes.head: THE BURN
scenes.hook: PART OF THE SUPPLY IS BURNED ON A SCHEDULE
scenes.narration: The project burns some coins on a schedule, which slowly reduces the total supply.

scenes.head: THE LIMIT
scenes.narration: Critics say a small validator set makes the chain less decentralized, and it is closely tied to one company.
